glossary.Warrant: signed mandate and receipts bound to a Rider. $29/mo · $290/yr.
glossary.CuNi: one program, 119 languages, same stdout or refuse. Studio $0. Closed-app exception $490/yr.
glossary.TRU8: zeros specialist. 1 000 000 zeros → 8 bytes, round-trip. npm @cptasz13/tru8.
glossary.pulsar: free GPLv3 compressor you run on your own machine. Closed embed $490/yr.
glossary.Suite: metered encode/decode jobs. First 2 GB/month free, then 8¢/GB.
